note: Wikimedia Commons, “Блаженная Матрона Московская (13899411716).jpg”; artist as recorded there: Иконописная мастерская Елеон — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as «Икона Матроны Московской» painted by the Eleon icon workshop and files it under Category:Icons of Matrona of Moscow. It is the blind eldress Matrona Nikonova of Sebino and Moscow (1881-1952), the folder's righteous wonderworker - expressly not Matrona of Thessalonica, nor Matrona of Perge kept on 9 November, nor Matrona of Chios, all of whom have separate Commons categories. Commons describes it: Икона Матроны Московской, созданная в Иконописной Мастерской "Елеон".
